query: 查询生产环境所有交换机的列表
sql: SELECT * FROM EntNetworkElement WHERE device_type = '交换机' AND idc_room = '生产机房'

query: 查询名称为core-switch-01的交换机最近一小时的CPU利用率
sql: SELECT e.device_name, k.cpu_usage, k.collect_time FROM EntNetworkElement e JOIN EntNetworkElement2kpi k ON e.device_id = k.device_id WHERE e.device_name = 'core-switch-01' AND k.collect_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

query: 查询所有交换机最近24小时的CPU利用率趋势
sql: SELECT e.device_name, k.avg_cpu, k.stat_time FROM EntNetworkElement e JOIN kpi_network_device_info k ON e.device_id = k.device_id WHERE e.device_type = '交换机' AND k.stat_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

query: 查询网络中所有交换机设备的内存使用率
sql: SELECT e.device_name, k.memory_usage FROM EntNetworkElement e JOIN EntNetworkElement2kpi k ON e.device_id = k.device_id WHERE e.device_type = '交换机'
SELECT e.device_name, s.slot_model, s.slot_no FROM EntNetworkElement e JOIN EnterpriseSlot s ON e.device_id = s.device_id

query: 查询某台设备所有单板的CPU利用率
sql: SELECT s.slot_no, k.cpu_usage FROM EnterpriseSlot s JOIN EnterpriseSlot2kpi k ON s.slot_id = k.slot_id WHERE s.device_id = 'DEV001'

query: 查询所有单板最近一小时的温度情况
sql: SELECT s.slot_model, k.temperature FROM EnterpriseSlot s JOIN EnterpriseSlot2kpi k ON s.slot_id = k.slot_id WHERE k.collect_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

query: 查询单板的历史性能趋势
sql: SELECT s.slot_no, p.avg_temperature, p.stat_time FROM EnterpriseSlot s JOIN kpi_network_slot_info p ON s.slot_id = p.slot_id

query: 查询全网路由器设备的端口流量
sql: SELECT e.device_name, k.port_traffic FROM EntNetworkElement e JOIN EntNetworkElement2kpi k ON e.device_id = k.device_id WHERE e.device_type = '路由器'

query: 查询全部的闪存存储设备
查询闪存存储设备的LUN组信息
sql: SELECT s.storage_name, l.lun_group_name, l.lun_count FROM StorageDevice s JOIN LUNGroup l ON s.storage_id = l.storage_id

query: 查询名称为LUN-GROUP-01的LUN组的详细信息
查询数据库服务器最近一天的内存使用率
sql: SELECT e.device_name, k.memory_usage FROM EntNetworkElement e JOIN EntNetworkElement2kpi k ON e.device_id = k.device_id WHERE e.device_type = '服务器' AND k.collect_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY

query: 查询所有网元的告警信息
sql: SELECT * FROM EntNetworkElement WHERE status = '告警'

query: 查询交换机端口带宽利用率超过80%的设备
sql: SELECT e.device_name, k.bandwidth_usage FROM EntNetworkElement e JOIN EntNetworkElement2kpi k ON e.device_id = k.device_id WHERE e.device_type = '交换机' AND k.bandwidth_usage > 80
